measures.title: Average calcium by survey day
measures.sub: Average of the calcium readings taken on each survey day. The April 2021 surveys read three to four times higher than every survey since.
measures.where: SURVEY_DATE IS NOT NULL AND CALCIUM_READING IS NOT NULL

measures.title: eDNA samples by agency
measures.sub: eDNA samples collected in July and August 2024, by the agency that took them.

xNames.TERC: UC Davis Tahoe Environmental Research Center

measures.title: Room nights rented each year, by jurisdiction
measures.sub: Rooms rented in hotels, motels, casino hotels, and vacation rentals. 2018 has no Washoe County figures, and 2024 is incomplete.

measures.title: Room nights rented each year, by lodging type
measures.sub: The same room nights, by the kind of lodging. 2018 has no Washoe County figures, and 2024 is incomplete.

measures.title: Hotel and motel occupancy by month
measures.sub: Share of available rooms rented in each month, one line a year. Zones 1 to 5 are in the City of South Lake Tahoe.
measures.where: MonthNum IS NOT NULL AND OccupancyRate IS NOT NULL AND Category <> 'VHR'

measures.title: Sand Harbor visitors by season
measures.sub: Visitors counted at Sand Harbor in each season, May through April.

measures.title: Sand Harbor visitors by month
measures.sub: Average visitors in each month of the year, over the 12 seasons from 2010 to 2022.

measures.title: Rides each month, by service
measures.sub: Monthly ridership on each service, July 2017 through October 2023.

measures.title: Rides each year, by service
measures.sub: Full years only: the record starts in July 2017, and its last complete month is October 2023.
measures.where: MONTH NOT LIKE '%-17' AND MONTH NOT LIKE '%-23'

measures.title: Rides by month of the year
measures.sub: All services together, one line a year. 2017 starts in July, and 2023 ends in October.

measures.title: Mode share in TRPA travel surveys
measures.sub: Share of survey responses by way of traveling. Choose summer or winter surveys.

measures.title: Mode share in Replica
measures.sub: Share of estimated trips on one day in each season modeled. Choose the day.

measures.title: Mode share in LOCUS
measures.sub: Share of estimated trips on one kind of day in each quarter measured. Choose the day.
